rationale: One major finding (CR-001): the delete-run catch block showed a generic error even for 409 Conflict responses. All other checks passed.

standards_review.notes: All commits carry EPMCDME-10682 prefix and use conventional format.
No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no secrets, no open redirects introduced.

findings.problem: handleDeleteConfirm catch block uses a bare catch{} and always shows the generic 'Failed to delete run' toast, even when the server responds 409 Conflict (run still in progress).
findings.impact: User receives no meaningful feedback when attempting to delete a running run; they cannot know whether to wait and retry.
findings.recommendation: Import HttpError, change catch block to catch (err), and branch on instanceof HttpError && err.response.status === 409 to show 'Cannot delete a run that is still in progress.'
